newsitem.title: USA: Explosion rocks Atlanta abortion clinic.
newsitem.headline: Explosion rocks Atlanta abortion clinic.

text.p: An explosion rocked a five-story building housing an Atlanta abortion clinic on Thursday, police said.

"It appears to have been some sort of device. It was not a natural explosion," said Fulton County Police Lt. C.C. Cass. There were no immediate reports of injuries from the blast, which occurred at around 9:30 a.m. EST.
Police said there was no warning of a bomb at the facility, which was identified by local press reports as the Atlanta Northside Family Planning Services.
"The structure's standing. There's smoke damage, some windows broken," said Cass.
Eyewitnesses said the explosion shook nearby office buildings.
The FBI and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms were expected to join local police and fire officials in an investigation of the blast sight.
